global.trigger_en: One or more fields are invalid.
global.trigger_id: Satu atau beberapa field tidak valid.

global.trigger_en: The session is missing, expired, or revoked.
global.trigger_id: Sesi tidak ada, kedaluwarsa, atau dicabut.
global.default_message_en: Your session is invalid or has expired. Please sign in again.
global.default_message_id: Sesi Anda tidak valid atau sudah berakhir. Silakan masuk lagi.

global.trigger_en: The user lacks the required permission or scope.
global.trigger_id: Pengguna tidak memiliki izin atau scope yang diperlukan.
global.default_message_en: The request could not be processed.

global.meaning_en: Not found or out of scope
global.meaning_id: Tidak ditemukan atau di luar scope
global.trigger_en: The resource does not exist or belongs to another tenant/scope.
global.trigger_id: Resource tidak ada atau milik tenant/scope lain.

global.trigger_en: The version does not match or a unique value already exists.
global.trigger_id: Versi tidak cocok atau nilai unik sudah dipakai.
global.default_message_en: The data has changed. Reload and try again.
global.default_message_id: Data telah berubah. Muat ulang lalu coba lagi.

global.default_message_en: Too many requests. Please try again later.
global.default_message_id: Terlalu banyak permintaan. Coba lagi nanti.

global.trigger_en: The same Idempotency-Key was used with a different payload.
global.trigger_id: Idempotency-Key yang sama dipakai dengan payload berbeda.
global.default_message_en: This request conflicts with a previous request. Check the result before trying again.
global.default_message_id: Permintaan ini bertentangan dengan permintaan sebelumnya. Periksa hasilnya sebelum mencoba lagi.

global.trigger_en: The HTTP method or media type is not supported.
global.trigger_id: Metode HTTP atau media type tidak didukung.
global.default_message_en: The request method or format is not supported.
global.default_message_id: Metode atau format permintaan tidak didukung.

global.trigger_en: The request body or upload exceeds the configured limit.
global.trigger_id: Body permintaan atau unggahan melebihi batas yang dikonfigurasi.

global.trigger_en: The CSRF token is missing, invalid, or expired.
global.trigger_id: Token CSRF tidak ada, tidak valid, atau kedaluwarsa.
global.default_message_en: Your security token is invalid or has expired. Reload the page and try again.
global.default_message_id: Token keamanan tidak valid atau sudah berakhir. Muat ulang halaman lalu coba lagi.

global.trigger_en: An unhandled error or panic occurred.
global.trigger_id: Terjadi error atau panic yang tidak tertangani.
global.default_message_en: The request could not be processed.

global.trigger_en: An adapter or dependency failed or timed out.
global.trigger_id: Adapter atau dependensi gagal atau timeout.
global.default_message_en: A supporting service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
global.default_message_id: Layanan pendukung sedang tidak tersedia. Coba lagi nanti.

module.trigger_en: The local email/password pair does not match.
module.trigger_id: Pasangan email/kata sandi lokal tidak cocok.
module.action_en: Record the failed attempt; keep the message generic.
module.action_id: Catat percobaan gagal; pesan tetap generik.

module.trigger_en: The user is authenticated but has no active company membership.
module.trigger_id: Pengguna terautentikasi tetapi tidak memiliki membership perusahaan yang aktif.
module.default_message_en: You do not have an active membership in this company.
module.default_message_id: Anda tidak memiliki keanggotaan aktif di perusahaan ini.
module.action_en: Reject access and direct the user to an administrator.
module.action_id: Tolak akses dan arahkan pengguna ke administrator.

module.action_en: Keep the message generic and audit the attempt.
module.action_id: Pesan tetap generik dan percobaan dicatat di audit.

module.trigger_en: The HRIS returned 5xx or timed out.
module.default_message_en: The identity service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
module.default_message_id: Layanan identitas sedang tidak tersedia. Coba lagi nanti.
module.action_en: Fail closed and alert the HRIS owner.
module.action_id: Fail-closed dan beri alert ke pemilik HRIS.

module.default_message_en: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait and try again.
module.default_message_id: Terlalu banyak percobaan masuk. Tunggu lalu coba lagi.

module.trigger_en: The HRIS response could not be parsed or mapped.
module.trigger_id: Respons HRIS tidak dapat diparse atau dipetakan.
module.default_message_en: The identity service returned an invalid response. Please contact an administrator.
module.default_message_id: Layanan identitas mengembalikan respons yang tidak valid. Hubungi administrator.
module.action_en: Fail closed and alert the administrator.
module.action_id: Fail-closed dan beri alert ke administrator.

module.trigger_en: The role_map produced no valid company role.
module.trigger_id: role_map tidak menghasilkan role perusahaan yang valid.
module.default_message_en: Your account is not configured for this company. Please contact an administrator.
module.default_message_id: Akun Anda belum dikonfigurasi untuk perusahaan ini. Hubungi administrator.
module.action_en: Reject login and log the mapping failure for administrators.
module.action_id: Tolak login dan catat kegagalan mapping untuk administrator.

module.trigger_en: A second active check-out was attempted.
module.default_message_en: This asset is currently checked out.
module.action_en: Show the current holder only if the user may see it.
module.action_id: Tampilkan pemegang saat ini hanya jika pengguna boleh melihatnya.

module.trigger_en: Execution was attempted without an approved change.
module.trigger_id: Eksekusi dicoba tanpa perubahan yang disetujui.

module.trigger_en: Management connectivity was lost after the change.
module.default_message_en: The firewall change was rolled back.
module.action_en: Open an incident and record the audit event.
module.action_id: Buka insiden dan catat audit event.

module.trigger_en: The compose file uses a mutable tag.
module.trigger_id: File compose memakai tag yang dapat berubah.
module.default_message_en: The image must be pinned to a digest.

module.meaning_en: Health check failed and rollback ran
module.meaning_id: Health check gagal dan rollback dijalankan
module.trigger_en: The new revision did not become healthy.
module.default_message_en: The health check failed and the deployment was rolled back.
module.default_message_id: Health check gagal dan deployment dikembalikan.

module.action_en: Use dual control and link the approval.
module.action_id: Gunakan dual control dan tautkan persetujuan.

module.action_en: Reject approval and ask for a new request.
module.action_id: Tolak persetujuan dan minta permintaan baru.

field.default_message_en: The value is outside your scope.
field.default_message_id: Nilai berada di luar scope Anda.

field.default_message_en: The referenced value was not found.
This value is already in use.
This value conflicts with the current state.
field.default_message_id: Nilai ini bertentangan dengan status saat ini.

field.default_message_en: This action is not allowed in the current state.
field.default_message_id: Aksi ini tidak diizinkan pada keadaan saat ini.
